items.original_text: An explanation for why my mana barely answered.
items.provider_text: An explanation for why my mah-nah barely answered.
items.previous_text: Proof that time had moved backward.
items.next_text: A list of people I remembered losing.

items.original_text: Mana conditioning would cost too, once I found someone willing to teach a nineteen-year-old whose mana currently answered like a sleepy cat.
items.provider_text: Mah-nah conditioning would cost too, once I found someone willing to teach a nineteen-year-old whose mah-nah currently answered like a sleepy cat.
items.previous_text: One silver for instruction. Copper for additional yard blocks. More for practice gear if I broke anything. More for healer access. More for food if I wanted the body to recover properly.
items.next_text: I had three copper this morning.

items.original_text: Cheap. Brittle. Mildly mana-reactive. Mostly used where nobody cared if it cracked.
items.provider_text: Cheap. Brittle. Mildly mah-nah-reactive. Mostly used where nobody cared if it cracked.
items.previous_text: I stopped.
items.next_text: Later, it mattered.

items.original_text: I asked whether he worked with mana-reactive ceramic mixes.
items.provider_text: I asked whether he worked with mah-nah-reactive ceramic mixes.
items.next_text: Sometimes.

items.original_text: “Trace mana. Cheap structure. High surface area if powdered. I think heat changes how it binds residue.”
items.provider_text: “Trace mah-nah. Cheap structure. High surface area if powdered. I think heat changes how it binds residue.”
items.previous_text: I made myself stay with what I actually had.
items.next_text: He looked at the bucket again.

items.original_text: Mana conditioning would cost once I found a teacher.
items.provider_text: Mah-nah conditioning would cost once I found a teacher.
items.previous_text: Food mattered if I intended to train every day.
items.next_text: Rent would eventually become interested in me.

items.original_text: Not the calendar. Not the tally marks beside my bed. Not the increasingly complicated page where I had attempted to track training, debt, food, mana, shale, and several financial decisions that became less defensible when arranged chronologically.
items.provider_text: Not the calendar. Not the tally marks beside my bed. Not the increasingly complicated page where I had attempted to track training, debt, food, mah-nah, shale, and several financial decisions that became less defensible when arranged chronologically.
items.previous_text: That was how I noticed the month.
items.next_text: Sella looked up when I entered, reached beneath the counter, and slid the yard register toward me before I had finished reaching for the token.

items.original_text: My mana had improved from almost nothing to a small stable pulse I could hold for several breaths.
items.provider_text: My mah-nah had improved from almost nothing to a small stable pulse I could hold for several breaths.
items.previous_text: The shale experiment had produced one repeatable improvement and several expensive ways to make ugly ceramic.
items.next_text: That had also developed a price.

items.original_text: He had changed the clay body first, then the firing schedule. He thought flow mattered more than the mana reaction I had originally obsessed over.
items.provider_text: He had changed the clay body first, then the firing schedule. He thought flow mattered more than the mah-nah reaction I had originally obsessed over.
items.previous_text: That distinction mattered.
items.next_text: I thought surface area still mattered.

items.original_text: Mana.
items.provider_text: Mah-nah.
items.previous_text: The hair on my forearm lifted.
items.next_text: Very little.

items.original_text: Pigment. Binding salt. Ash treatment. A cheap mana-set additive used to keep the darker purple from washing gray.
items.provider_text: Pigment. Binding salt. Ash treatment. A cheap mah-nah-set additive used to keep the darker purple from washing gray.
items.previous_text: Ivena listed things I mostly understood.
items.next_text: There.

items.original_text: Mana-set additive.
items.provider_text: Mah-nah-set additive.
items.previous_text: There.
items.next_text: How much?

items.original_text: Mana-bearing residue.
items.provider_text: Mah-nah-bearing residue.
items.previous_text: Metal.
items.next_text: People standing inside it.

items.original_text: Reached for mana.
items.provider_text: Reached for mah-nah.
items.previous_text: I put out my hand.
items.next_text: The remembered motion was enormous.

items.original_text: Mana answered this time.
items.provider_text: Mah-nah answered this time.
items.previous_text: Instinct.
items.next_text: Not a wall.

items.original_text: Maybe mana salt.
items.provider_text: Maybe mah-nah salt.
items.previous_text: Concentration.
items.next_text: Maybe all of them.

items.original_text: Maybe mana would take longer.
items.provider_text: Maybe mah-nah would take longer.
items.previous_text: My sword had taken a month to become mine.
items.next_text: Maybe much longer.

items.original_text: No mana.
items.provider_text: No mah-nah.
items.previous_text: I ran.
items.next_text: Did not even reach for it.

items.original_text: Support work involved other people's bodies, mana loads, ward interactions, healing delays, movement assumptions, and the general problem that a bad support mage could make competent people wrong at exactly the dangerous moment.
items.provider_text: Support work involved other people's bodies, mah-nah loads, ward interactions, healing delays, movement assumptions, and the general problem that a bad support mage could make competent people wrong at exactly the dangerous moment.
items.previous_text: The Guild would happily rent me a patch of dirt and let me become worse at swordsmanship alone.

items.original_text: Current mana.
items.provider_text: Current mah-nah.
items.previous_text: Current body.
items.next_text: No historical exemptions for having once been impressive.

items.original_text: Training harder than my mana could support was one.
items.provider_text: Training harder than my mah-nah could support was one.
items.previous_text: I was experienced in most of them.
items.next_text: Buying things because waiting felt passive was another.

items.original_text: No mana crawling across the floor.
items.provider_text: No mah-nah crawling across the floor.
items.previous_text: No heat problem.
items.next_text: No cracked ceramic.

items.original_text: Dyehouse sludge had taught us about heat, flow, concentration, and mana-bearing waste.
items.provider_text: Dyehouse sludge had taught us about heat, flow, concentration, and mah-nah-bearing waste.
items.previous_text: Of course.
items.next_text: Tannery water had brought skin, hair, lime, fat, bark solids, and several things I decided not to identify while standing near breakfast.

items.original_text: Mana gathered badly, then enough.
items.provider_text: Mah-nah gathered badly, then enough.
items.previous_text: My hand moved before I finished thinking.
items.next_text: A support plane snapped into place between the falling plaster and the side of his face.
